codeReview.summary: The fix directly addresses the prior blocking failure: `--path-to-ignore` and `-p` now require values and surface missing-value cases through the invalid-option error path (stderr diagnostic, usage on stdout, exit 1). Added parity tests cover both missing-value and with-value cases for both flags. No additional issues were found in the reviewed scope.
